nl_spec: Design a single-ended voltage amplifier in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 500 fF; input DC bias 0.75 V. Requirements: DC gain of at least -5 dB; -3 dB bandwidth of at least 790 MHz; gain-bandwidth product of at least 1.5 GHz; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 2.7 mW; output DC level between 0.45 V and 1.35 V.
